titles.romaji: Arifureta Shokugyou de Sekai Saikyou Picture Drama
titles.native: ありふれた職業で世界最強 ピクチャードラマ

description:
An online motion graphic series that provides a comedic interpretation of events that have occurred in conjunction with the anime.

Note: These episodes were originally posted on the series' official Twitter page on a weekly basis coinciding with the anime's broadcast, and were later included in the BD-BOX sets 1 through 3.
